{{Wireless adapter |brand=TRENDnet |model=TEW-804UB |revision=V1.0R / A1 |asin=B00FS9GRXW |fcc_date=07/18/2013 |manuf_country=China |is_manuf=No |manuf=Cameo |if=USB |if_bus_version=2.0 |if_connector_type=Male A |form_factor=micro dongle |vendor_id=20f4 |device_id=804b |fcc_id=XU8TEW804UB |chip1_brand=Realtek |chip1_model=RTL8811AU |accessible_UART=No |flags=DFS, |802dot11_protocols=abgn+ac |txchains=1 |rxchains=1 |sstreams=1 |oui=D8:EB:97 }} '''AC600 Dual Band USB Adapter''' "Ver:A0-0 13/01/10" appears to be silkscreened on the RTL IC side of the board. :"Made in China" and a ''Plotech'' logo is silkscreened on the other side of the board. This is a micro sized dongle. It's about half or a bit less in length than
a full size dongle.. and about the same size as the [[Linksys AE6000]]. Some similar models include [[Edimax EW-7811UTC]] and [[LM Technologies LM808]]. :Though these devices seem identical to the TEW-804UB this device does not seem to :work with the driver for RTL8811AU/RTL8812AU/RTL8821AU modified with correct USB ID.
